Ambient temperature 22 °C (TMPA) stated by the user; the ScenarioSpec schema has no field for it, so it must be set via MISC TMPA=22 when the FDS file is generated.
Burner footprint 0.24 m x 0.25 m = 0.06 m2, giving HRRPUA ≈ 1048 kW/m2, within the 250-2500 range.
Constant fire: full 62.9 kW from t = 0 (growth='constant'), with no time_to_peak.
Methane fuel CH4 (C=1, H=4, O=0, N=0) with heat of combustion 50 000 kJ/kg, a conventional value.
The schema needs soot yield > 0, so soot_yield = 0.001 is used as a near-zero value for clean methane combustion. The reference case uses 0.
CO yield 0.0 for methane burning with good ventilation.
Front wall 0.10 m thick, as the user specified, rather than the generic 0.2 m. Its surface is the default INERT.
The door hole (x 2.75..2.95) extends past both faces of the wall so it cuts fully through.
Uniform 0.05 m cells (72 x 56 x 44 = 177 408 cells, one mesh).
Device output every 1 s and slice output every 5 s (defaults). Simulation length 400 s, as the user specified.
No mechanical exhaust or make-up air: ventilation is natural, through the door and the open outside boundaries.
